title: paper_code
description: Code's steps at one paper order (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 119): research/orders/<N>/code.json, written only by wayline.paper_code through the ledger before the writer launches. The tag paper-N on main and whether the code repository's split was pushed with it; the scripts behind the figures and the cited drawing numbers copied into code/figures/; the environment file and the Dockerfile rendered from the locks; each result whose code changed since its run, re-run at the tag, with its outcome and the ticket cut when its numbers moved; and the code-to-Methods check over all of code/.

commit.description: the commit of main tagged paper-N; null when the project has no repository

split.description: the code repository's split commit at the tag

pushed.description: whether the split and the tag reached the code repository's remote

push_problem.description: why nothing was tagged or pushed

committed.description: the commit on main carrying what the order rendered into code/, null when nothing changed

file.description: the copy under code/figures/, null when the drawing's script is not on disk

figures.description: the planned figures and tables it is behind

findings.description: the findings citing a number it computes

environment.description: the environment file and the Dockerfile written under code/

kept.description: the owner's files of those names, kept, with wayline's beside them

stale.description: the results whose code changed since their runs, null before they were read

jobs.description: the jobs that made them, each once

sessions.description: the stale runs no job made, which code cannot re-run

devices.description: the GPUs (gpu:<uuid>) and cores (core:<n>) it holds while it runs

cut.description: the ticket cut when its numbers moved
